scenario_description:
Objective: Keep tomorrow’s confirmed butter-tea song-practice table able to serve the drink guests planned around.
Emerging Need: The gathering becomes definite and supplies are bought before the helpers learn their only hand churn is unusable.
Decision Context: A pre-existing hosting note identifies the no-cost, time-limited equipment hold and the low-commitment wording that fits Sahana’s authority.
Consequence: Timely handling preserves the planned pour without binding other people; after the hold cutoff, the documented no-cost library loan cannot be secured for this afternoon. Other equipment sources or a changed menu remain separate possibilities.

parameter.subject: Saturday song-practice tea idea
parameter.body: The rec-room song-practice circle may happen tomorrow late afternoon. Before I tell the aunties anything, are we still only floating the butter-tea idea until the room is definite?

parameter.content: Kunsang Dolma and Appa both liked the quieter song-practice plan and said they would come if we keep it to butter tea and familiar songs. I told them we still had to confirm the rec room.

parameter.title: Butter-tea song practice
parameter.description: Confirmed small rec-room table with butter tea and familiar songs for elders who prefer a quiet gathering.
parameter.location: Kalsang Building rec room, Jackson Heights

parameter.description: Tea brick, butter, and salt for the Nov. 7 rec-room butter-tea table.

parameter.content: Packing the helpers’ bag now: my hand churn has cracked at the hinge and will not seal. I can still bring cups and salt, but we should assume there is no working churn in the bag for today’s butter tea.

parameter.subject: Today’s kitchen-equipment shelf cutoff has passed
parameter.body: Neighborhood note: same-day hand-churn holds for afternoon pickup closed at 11:30 a.m. today. Unheld pieces are now being packed for the Jackson Heights demo table, and the shelf volunteer cannot open new holds this afternoon.
